news.headline: McManus' Sunday performance extends his perfect streak with a Rams' special teams unit that desperately needed consisten
news.detail: McManus' Sunday performance extends his perfect streak with a Rams' special teams unit that desperately needed consistency at kicker. He's now 5-for-5 on field-goal attempts and 14-for-14 on PATs after five regular-season contests as a Ram in 2026.
